Awaken

A fast 3D combo roguelike. You are an axe-wielding shaman fighting through rooms of skeletons to the Bone Warden. Light and heavy strings, dash cancels, launches and juggles feed a style rank, the style rank fills Awakening, and every reward is a power bolted onto one specific move.

data.js is missing. Run python tools/wiki.py from the repo.

Play it in Godot

Godot 4.7 (the mono build is fine; the game is all GDScript) on your PATH as godot.

  1. Fastest: launch straight into the game

    godot --path "C:\Users\pruit\Desktop\dev\awaken"

    The title screen opens in a 1600×900 window. Pick Start run.

  2. Or open it in the editor

    Run godot on its own for the Project Manager → Import → awaken\project.godot → Import & Edit. The first open re-imports models and sounds (about a minute). Press F5 to play, F8 to stop. Most of the game is built in code, so the scene tree looks nearly empty.

  3. Skip ahead to what you want to see

    Anything after -- goes to the game. These work in normal play:

    godot --path "C:\Users\pruit\Desktop\dev\awaken" -- --start-room=8 --boss-enraged
    • --start-room=8 fights the Bone Warden; --boss-enraged starts its second phase.
    • --twist=splitting (or volatile, armored, hasted; comma-separated for two) makes room 1 an elite room.
    • --upgrades=shatter,bone_breaker starts with those powers (ids are in the Powers table).
    • --start-shrine / --start-rest open on a shrine or camp with 30 bones. --start-awakened starts with a full meter.
    • --seed=N replays a run's doors and rewards.

  4. Gamepad

    Plug an Xbox-style pad in before launching. Rumble is in Settings.

Real play saves. Records, recent runs and banked bones live in %APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\Awaken\ (settings.cfg, records.cfg, altar.cfg). Delete them to start fresh. The PNGs there are test screenshots.

Moves & combos

The moveset is fixed: a light chain, a heavy that changes with what came before it, a charged heavy, a dash attack and the Awakened finisher. Every move also summons the shaman's element (see Elements & ultimates). Landing a named combo plays a short sound for its tier and shows its name above the hero: string, heavy route, finisher. The pause menu lists the same moves.

Dash and the perfect dodge

Combo breakers

Five enders turn into a timed aerial finisher when they connect: Ground Breaker (L L H), Charged Slam, Flurry, Cyclone and Spike. He leaps up, the game slows, and he roars a war cry as the window opens. The floor under him answers in his element: pebbles and embers for earth, frost for water, lightning for wind, wisps for spirit. Press heavy while the rings close on the circle by his head. Where they meet is a PERFECT (x1.5 damage). Too early locks it out, but the ender's own mashed press is ignored and a press a hair early is held for the window. No press and he floats down.

The dive comes down like a comet in his element and breaks the floor. Glowing cracks split out and vent the element (embers, frost, sparks, wisps), slabs heave up round the rim, and rubble flies. On a PERFECT the element erupts in a ring round the crater (Flurry's dash erupts down its line instead).

The air string

L H L L is Sky Rend up in the air. Heavy there is the Updraft: a gale funnel roars up under him, carrying his element round it, and lifts him higher than he can normally climb. A spinning vortex holds him up until he lands. Light then is Gale Waltz: three cuts that fling wind blades raking down onto the floor, left, right, then a big crossed X dead ahead. Light after that is Stormfall, a Triple Chop from the very top that falls like a comet, cracks the floor into a crater under a shockwave dome and makes the element erupt round it.

The shaman

An enhancement shaman with twin rune-carved axes, a grey wolf-pelt hood, feathers and a bead-and-fang necklace. The axes shimmer teal at rest.

Awakening calls the ancestors: the shaman glows gold until reaching level , then takes on the chosen element's colour and power.

Built on the KayKit Barbarian. The texture is recoloured by tools/gen_shaman_texture.gd, and the extra pieces come from scripts/hero_look.gd.

Style & Awakening

Each hit adds style. A move you haven't used recently is worth four times a repeat, so mixing routes climbs the rank and mashing one button stalls it. Higher ranks fill Awakening faster, and the combat music layer fades in with your rank.

Levels & Ascendancy

Elements & ultimates

The shaman fights with the elements as much as with the axes. Every attack summons the hero's element: spirit (teal and gold) before an Ascendancy, then wind, earth or water. Casts deal their own damage on top of the swing, and while Awakened they also trigger the path's passive (lightning, chill). Motes of the element circle the hero, more of them while Awakened.

        Daily runs, seeds and records

        Every run has a seed shown on the pause menu and the summary. Daily run seeds from the date, so everyone on this build gets the same map and offers that day. The title lists your last five runs; pick one to replay its seed. Records track best room, combo, rank, juggle and fastest win. The run summary also shows the combos found, your signature combo (the one landed most) and your busiest power (the one that fired most).

        Test flags

        Autotest, tour and wiki commands
        • -- --autotest runs a 16s bot playthrough, saves screenshots and prints a stats line. It never touches your saves.
        • -- --autotest --tour forces fight → rest → shrine → elite → boss and prints PASS/FAIL.
        • -- --autotest --pace --start-room=3 --twist=splitting stops at the first clear and prints the clear time.
        • --boss-attack=cage makes the Warden use only that attack. --reduce-flashing turns that setting on without saving.
        • godot --path . -s tests/menu_check.gd screenshots the menus.
        • python tools/wiki.py rebuilds this page's numbers; add --shots to re-capture the screenshots.
